approvers: Owner/director, plus the developer or main contractor who pays for it
reason: I've never seen this used on a Maltese job. We wrap frames in cheap film and tape and clean off the cement ourselves, so EUR 19 a square metre is a new budget line for something I can't recommend to the boss without proof.
objection: Never seen it used in Malta. Who has had it on a job here, and what happens when it won't peel clean after a summer in the sun?
instead: Keep using protection film, tape and cardboard from the hardware store, and have the labourers clean the glass at snagging.
would_change_my_mind: A local reference job I can visit, with a main contractor I know vouching for it, and a free test panel on one of our own floors.
